feeds.title: Emma Block Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Emma Block is a multidisciplinary illustrator living in London, working across editorial illustration, publishing, packaging and branding. Emma's work is inspired by the people she meets in her everyday life, old photos, vintage clothes, old films, travel, 1950s illustration, 1930s jazz and sausage dogs.

feeds.title: Arena Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Arena illustration represents a diverse group of illustrators with an array of distinctive styles. Beautiful and eye-catching illustrations for book covers, children's books, magazines and newspapers, designs for packaging and advertising campaigns.

feeds.title: Alice Potter Children's Illustration Blog
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Alice Rebecca Potter. My work is known for its color and cute characters and I particularly enjoy designing and illustrating for children. In the past 18 months, I have been busy illustrating a number of children's books for publishers in the UK, Europe, and the US.

feeds.title: Good Illustration
feeds.description: Good Illustration is an International Illustration Agency.

feeds.title: Spoon Graphics
feeds.description: I'm Chris Spooner, the guy behind the Spoon Graphics design blog. Follow this blog for Photoshop & Illustrator design tutorials, graphic design articles and free resource download.

feeds.title: Sarah Goodreau
feeds.description: Sarah Goodreau is an Illustrator/Author living in London, UK. She was born in Massachusettes, USA and attended the Savannah College of Art and Design where she received a BFA in Illustration. Since then Sarah has worked for for various publications illustrating for children's books. She is also the co-creator and art director of Wizard Fingers, an animation group.

feeds.title: Paper And Cloth Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Paper & Cloth blog. We are a UK print, design and illustration studio, producing charming, quirky and original art.We love to draw, armed with boundless imagination and fantastic illustrators we love creating new characters, prints and exploring new trends.
